Title: EPIC-001: Core Speech Recognition (ASR)
Body:
**Description:**
Design and implement the core Speech Recognition capability using Whisper to convert English medical dictation into accurate text suitable for ultrasound reporting.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Supports English medical dictation
- Achieves >95% word accuracy for ultrasound terms
- Processes audio < 2 seconds latency (batch)

Title: Task 1: Install WSL2
Body:
**Description:**
Initialize WSL2 and Ubuntu on Windows.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Ubuntu terminal works
- Can run bash commands

Title: Task 2: Install Python & venv
Body:
**Description:**
Install Python 3.11 and create virtual environment.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Python 3.11 installed
- venv works

Title: Task 3: Install CUDA & Drivers
Body:
**Description:**
Install NVIDIA CUDA toolkit and drivers.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- nvidia-smi shows GPU
- PyTorch CUDA available

Title: Task 4: Install Python Packages
Body:
**Description:**
Install PyTorch, Transformers, bitsandbytes, accelerate.
